تستنفوا (form X)
# تَسْتَنْفُوا (tastanfū) /tas.tan.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْفَى (istanfā)
# تُسْتَنْفَوْا (tustanfaw) /tus.tan.faw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْفَى (istanfā)
